claims: "No a la guerra" (No to war) is a Spanish peace slogan.
"No a la guerra" was used in Spain against the 2003 Iraq war.
"No a la guerra" was recently seen in 2026 as a statement against conflicts like in Palestine.
Actors and public figures have worn "No a la guerra" pins to protest ongoing global conflicts.
Actors and public figures wearing "No a la guerra" pins to protest ongoing global conflicts was highlighted on Facebook and TikTok.
